test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

The teacher let the students __choose there__ essay topics.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**choose their**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**let**" is followed by an infinitive verb form without "**to**".
 
• In this case, it should be "**let the students choose**".
 
• The possessive pronoun "**their**" is used to show that the essay topics belong to the students.
 
• "**There**" is a location adverb and is not appropriate in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sentence:** *The teacher let the students choose their__ essay topics.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "**Has choose**" is incorrect because "has" is a present perfect auxiliary verb that should be paired with the past participle form of the main verb (e.g. has chosen).
 
• Option 3: "**Chosen there**" is incorrect because "chosen" is a past participle form of the verb "choose" and needs an auxiliary verb to complete the verb phrase (e.g. have chosen). "There" is still incorrect in this context.
